components.html:
About this form

This form illustrates that the person name type can be omitted if the person name type is evident based on the context, or a low level of confidence is required. In the case of the first field in this form ("Full name") the person name type is omitted. However, it is included in the remaining fields to indicate that they refer specifically to the name used person name type.

The Person Name Data Standard states:

It’s preferable not to split a person’s name into parts (e.g., either First Name, Middle Names, Last Name or Given Names, Last Name), as splitting-into-parts to reflect family names does not fit all naming and correspondence practices. For example, using just the first word of a name in an email greeting may not be appropriate in cases where a person’s name is a polynym or has multiple words making up their first name. Rather than assume the order of names indicates which to use in a greeting, use the “Name Used” Person Name Type. 

In this form the user is given a choice of which combination of components they wish to supply a Name Used for. The fields are initially populated from the corresponding parts of the full name. They may subsequently be edited.

components.description:
This is a person's full name; it includes all name components - first, middle, last. 
The name may include any Unicode character, including those found in Indigenous and 
other non-English languages.

values.label: None - Name Used is the same as the Full name

components.tooltip: Select the name components you wish to specify for the Name Used
components.description:
"Name as parts" option for the Name Used. 
Select the name components that you wish to specify.

components.label: Name Used first name

errors.required: The first name field is required.
errors.maxLength: The first name field can have no more than 30 characters.

components.tooltip:
The first name portion of a person's full 'Name Used' name. 
It is a required field, with a maximum length of 30 characters. 
Note that this field may be the same as the first name inferred 
from the full name field. It may contain multiple words - e.g., 'Mary Ann'.
components.description:
This is the first name component of a person's full 'Name Used' name. 
It may contain multiple words. For example, 
for the full 'name'Name Used' is 'Mary Ann Smith', the first name may be either 
'Mary' or 'Mary Ann', 
depending on which name might be used in a personal greeting. If just 'Mary', then 'Ann' 
would appear in the middle name field. 
This field has a maximum length of 30 characters.

components.label: Name Used middle name(s)

errors.maxLength: The middle name field can have no more than 30 characters.

components.tooltip:
The middle names (all but the first and last name) portion of a person's full 'Name Used' name. 
It has a maximum length of 30 characters. 
It may contain multiple words - e.g., 'Stuart David' in the full name
'Robert Stuart David Brown'.
components.description:
These are the middle name component of a person's full 'Name Used' name. 
It may contain multiple words. For example, 
if the full Name Used' is 'Mary Ann Smith', the middle name may be either 
'Ann' or left blank, 
depending on which name might be used in a personal greeting. 
If just 'Mary', then 'Ann' 
would appear in the middle name field. 
This field has a maximum length of 30 characters.

components.label: Name Used last name

errors.maxLength: The last name field can have no more than 30 characters.

components.tooltip:
The surname portion of the full name by which a person is known. 
It may contain multiple words. For example, In the example 'Sarah St. John', the last name is 'St. John'
components.description:
This is the last name component of a person's full 'Name Used' name. 
It is restricted to 30 characters and may contain multiple words. For example, 
for the full name 'Sarah St. John', the last name is 'St. John'.  This field is
often supplied when the last name is different from the legal last name (due to marriage, for example).
